The company has market cap of $586.48 million. It accepts a range of deposit products, such as demand, NOW, money market, and savings accounts, as well as certificates of deposit. It has a 25.59 P/E ratio. The firm offers commercial and industrial loans, including lines of credit, revolving credit facilities, accounts receivable financing, term and equipment loans, small business administration loans, standby letters of credit, and unsecured loans; commercial real estate loans; funds for the construction of single family residences, financing to builders for the construction of pre-sold homes, and loans for multi-family housing, as well as home equity and home improvement loans; land acquisition and development loans; and consumer installment loans.
